Oneliner

Remotely estimate the geo-location of a femto-satellite using two CubeSats and the communication link.
Description

Remotely estimate the geo-location of a femto-satellite only using two station-CubeSats and the communication link between the femto-satellite and each CubeSat. The presented approach combines the Time Difference Of Arrival (TDOA) and Angle Of Arrival (AOA) methods.
